---
title: "World Flags Map"
format: html
resources:
  - w2560/*.png
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(geojsonsf)
library(png)

# Extract the color profile (red, green, blue, white, black, yellow) of a flag
get_flag_colors <- \(code) {
  path <- paste0("w2560/", code, ".png")
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(rep(NA_real_, 6))
  img <- readPNG(path)
  if (length(dim(img)) < 3) return(rep(NA_real_, 6))
  # Sample a grid of pixels for speed
  r <- as.vector(img[seq(1, nrow(img), 25), seq(1, ncol(img), 25), 1])
  g <- as.vector(img[seq(1, nrow(img), 25), seq(1, ncol(img), 25), 2])
  b <- as.vector(img[seq(1, nrow(img), 25), seq(1, ncol(img), 25), 3])
  c(
    red    = mean(r > 0.6 & g < 0.3 & b < 0.3),
    green  = mean(g > 0.4 & r < 0.4 & b < 0.4),
    blue   = mean(b > 0.4 & r < 0.3 & g < 0.5),
    white  = mean(r > 0.8 & g > 0.8 & b > 0.8),
    black  = mean(r < 0.2 & g < 0.2 & b < 0.2),
    yellow = mean(r > 0.7 & g > 0.6 & b < 0.3)
  )
}

world_sf <- ne_countries(returnclass = "sf") |>
  transmute(name = name, code = tolower(iso_a2_eh))

# Compute pairwise color distances to find the 3 closest flags for each country
color_mat <- t(sapply(world_sf$code, get_flag_colors))
dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(color_mat))

world_geojson <- world_sf |>
  mutate(
    similar = map_chr(seq_len(n()), \(i) {
      if (any(is.na(color_mat[i, ]))) return("")
      d <- dist_mat[i, ]
      d[i] <- Inf
      top3 <- order(d)[1:3]
      paste( paste0(world_sf$code[top3], ":", world_sf$name[top3]), collapse = "|" )
    })
  ) |>
  sf_geojson()

ojs_define(world_str = world_geojson)
```

```{ojs}
// Parse the GeoJSON string sent from R
world = JSON.parse(world_str)

// Track the currently clicked country
mutable clickedCountry = null

// Create an interactive Leaflet map where clicking a country pops up its flag
map = {
  const link = html`<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">`;
  document.head.appendChild(link);
  const L = await require("leaflet@1.9.4");

  const container = html`<div style="height: 550px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; background: #d8eaf8;"></div>`;
  yield container;

  const m = L.map(container).setView([20, 0], 2);

  L.geoJSON(world, {
    style: { color: "#ffffff", weight: 1, fillColor: "#4a90d9", fillOpacity: 0.85 },
    onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
      const { name, code } = feature.properties;
      layer.bindPopup(
        `<b>${name}</b><br><img src="w2560/${code}.png" width="160" style="border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: 6px;">`
      );
      layer.on("click", () => {
        mutable clickedCountry = feature.properties;
      });
    }
  }).addTo(m);
}

// Display the 3 flags with the same colors below the map when a country is clicked
similarSection = {
  if (!clickedCountry || !clickedCountry.similar) {
    return html`<p style="margin-top: 16px; color: #555;"><em>Click on any country on the map to see three other flags with the same colors.</em></p>`;
  }
  const matches = clickedCountry.similar.split("|").map(item => {
    const [code, name] = item.split(":");
    return html`<div style="text-align: center;">
      <img src="w2560/${code}.png" style="height: 100px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;">
      <div style="margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 600;">${name}</div>
    </div>`;
  });
  return html`<div style="margin-top: 20px;">
    <h4>Three flags with the same colors as ${clickedCountry.name}:</h4>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 12px;">${matches}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```
